abort.already_configured: This thermostat already belongs to a room.

user.title: Add a room
user.description: A new room starts in observe mode: it calculates and logs, and writes nothing to the thermostat until you select active mode.

data_description.buffer_entity: For a climate entity its set temperature is used, and for other entities their value.
data_description.buffer_fallback: Used while the heat pump exposes no set temperature, for example on its own weather curve. Keep it within about 2 °C of the real value.
data_description.outdoor_entity: Only logged for now, for learning later.
data_description.phase_offset: Set different values for different rooms, so that they do not all open together.
